title: A Autopsy for the Cipher
premise: When the coffin of town founder Elias Vane is exhumed for a routine insurance audit, Isandro Hartwell discovers it empty — and a cipher etched into the coffin lid that only his photographic memory can decode. The ledger hidden in the cipher reveals that Vane faked his death to expose an inheritance scheme built on forged wills and buried crimes, implicating the very families who now run the town. As Isandro falls for Vane's granddaughter Marisol, who is both suspect and ally, he must choose between handing the evidence to corrupt authorities or delivering justice himself. In the end, Isandro decodes the final entry, confronts the killer beneath the old foundry, and chooses love over duty by letting the truth burn the town's legacy rather than preserve it.
about_author: Rafael Almeida is a former forensic archivist from Lisbon who spent a decade cataloguing unsolved estate disputes before turning to fiction. He writes mysteries about memory, paper trails, and the lies families tell themselves.

chapters.title: The Weight of Empty Oak
chapters.summary: Isandro Hartwell's POV. Called to witness the exhumation of founder Elias Vane for a policy audit, Isandro watches the coffin open on nothing but river stones and a brass plate. His photographic memory fixes every detail of the scene. Emotional beat: professional detachment cracking into unease as the town's founding myth begins to rot.

chapters.title: Ledger of Names
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Reviewing Vane's insurance file, he notices dates that don't align and beneficiaries who died conveniently. He memorizes the entire file in one sitting. Emotional beat: the thrill of pattern recognition shadowed by the realization that someone powerful wanted this coffin sealed forever.

chapters.title: Marisol at the Gate
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. He visits Vane House to question the family and meets Marisol Vane, the founder's sharp-tongued granddaughter who seems more amused than grieving. Their verbal sparring leaves him off-balance. Emotional beat: reluctant attraction sparking against his suspicion that she knows more than she says.

chapters.title: What the Gravedigger Saw
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Isandro and the aging gravedigger Tomás Ferro. Tomás admits the coffin was heavy when it went down twenty years ago — heavier than a body should be. Emotional beat: dread deepening; the empty coffin was empty before burial, meaning the fraud began at the funeral itself.

chapters.title: Cipher in the Grain
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Examining photographs of the coffin lid, Isandro recognizes tool marks arranged as a substitution cipher keyed to hymn numbers. He decodes the first fragment: a list of names and sums. Emotional beat: exhilaration curdling into fear as the first name belongs to a man who drowned last spring.

chapters.title: The Founders' Dinner
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. At the annual Founders' Dinner, Marisol watches the town's leading families perform grief while quietly comparing notes on the exhumation. She slips Isandro a warning under the table. Emotional beat: her divided loyalty — protect the family name or finish what her grandfather started.

chapters.title: Drowned Man's Signature
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. He investigates the drowning of Rui Baptista, the first name in the cipher, and finds the 'accident' site bears marks of staging. Someone is executing the ledger's final entries. Emotional beat: urgency ignites — the cipher isn't a record of past crimes; it's a countdown.

chapters.title: Hymn Number Nine
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Following the hymn key to the abandoned chapel, Isandro finds a hidden cache: half a ledger, water-damaged, in Elias Vane's hand. It details forged wills transferring land to four families. Emotional beat: vindication and vertigo — the beloved founder was the architect of everything.

chapters.title: Ashes in the Archive
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. The county archive burns overnight, destroying probate records. Isandro realizes his decoded fragments are now the only surviving copies — inside his own head. Emotional beat: isolation and terror; his memory makes him both the last witness and the next target.

chapters.title: A Room With Two Locks
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Marisol discovers her grandfather's study was searched and confronts Isandro, each testing the other. They form a wary alliance: she has the second half of the ledger's key, hidden in a music box. Emotional beat: trust kindling between two people trained to suspect everyone.

chapters.title: The Music Box Cipher
chapters.summary: Shared POV. Combining the music box pins with the coffin cipher, they reconstruct the full ledger: Vane faked his death to document the inheritance conspiracy, planning to return and restore stolen lands. Emotional beat: grief transformed into purpose — Elias died completing his confession, not escaping it.

chapters.title: Chief Cordeiro's Offer
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Police Chief Cordeiro, whose family appears in the ledger, offers Isandro a promotion and silence, framing the exhumation as vandalism. Emotional beat: the theme crystallizes — justice through the law is owned by the guilty; Isandro must refuse and accept the consequences.

chapters.title: Blood on the Hymnal
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Tomás the gravedigger is found dead in the chapel, a hymnal pressed to his chest. Marisol realizes the killers are working through the cipher's names in reverse. Emotional beat: guilt and fury — their investigation painted a target on everyone who helped.

chapters.title: Twenty Years of Tide
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Reconstructing the night of the fake funeral, Isandro deduces Vane's body was moved by boat to the flooded foundry, where he lived out his final years writing the ledger. Emotional beat: strange tenderness for the old man who chose exile over complicity.

chapters.title: The Fourth Family
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Cross-referencing land deeds, they identify the mastermind: not one of the four beneficiary families, but the lawyer who drafted every will — Aurelio Sampaio, now the town's most respected patriarch. Emotional beat: cold clarity; the conspiracy has no head to cut off because it wears the law's face.

chapters.title: Interrogation by Firelight
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Isandro confronts Sampaio privately, reciting the ledger from memory. Sampaio counters calmly: without physical evidence, Isandro is just a madman defaming a saint. Emotional beat: despair — a perfect memory proves nothing the world will accept.

chapters.title: What Marisol Kept
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Marisol reveals she has known since childhood — her grandfather visited her in secret, leaving her the music box and a letter naming Sampaio. She stayed silent to protect her mother. Emotional beat: betrayal and forgiveness braided together; love against duty made intimate.

chapters.title: The Foundry Stands
chapters.summary: Shared POV. Following the ledger's coordinates, Isandro and Marisol reach the flooded foundry and find Vane's remains, his final testimony, and proof Sampaio's men are coming to destroy it. Emotional beat: resolve hardening into commitment — tonight they stop running.

chapters.title: High Water
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Sampaio's enforcers flood the foundry chamber to drown the evidence. Isandro memorizes the final pages as the water rises, then fights his way out with Marisol, losing the physical ledger but keeping its contents whole in his mind. Emotional beat: survival through sacrifice; the archive is now flesh.

chapters.title: Reading of the Ledger
chapters.summary: Shared POV. Instead of going to Cordeiro, they stage a public reading at the Founders' Hall during the anniversary ceremony, Isandro reciting the full ledger before the assembled town while Marisol displays the recovered coffin plate. Emotional beat: catharsis — justice performed outside the law, witnessed by everyone the law failed.

chapters.title: Sampaio's Last Will
chapters.summary: Isandro's POV. Cornered before the town, Sampaio attempts to burn the hall's records and flee; confronted with Vane's remains and his own forged signatures, he confesses in front of witnesses. State investigators arrive to find the case already solved. Emotional beat: grim satisfaction — the law arrives only to collect what truth has already won.

chapters.title: A Grave Worth Keeping
chapters.summary: Shared POV, epilogue. Months later, Vane is properly buried beside the restored chapel, his confession carved honestly into stone. Isandro resigns from insurance work; Marisol opens the family lands to the descendants of those the wills robbed. Emotional beat: quiet peace — love chosen over duty, and a town learning to live with its true history.
